access_links.label: Zenodo landing page and file inventory

description: Mario Araya and colleagues publish two Parquet files from time-domain simulations of stand-alone microgrids. Zenodo serves them under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The larger file compares traces generated with Python, PSIM and an FPGA-accelerated simulation program at a stated 50 ns step; the second contains FPGA real-time output. They can support numerical cross-checks and timing comparisons when developing microgrid simulation engines. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these paired simulation outputs. A limitation is that the landing page does not list electrical topology, component parameters, channel names or case count, so a modeller must inspect the files and associated study before using them as a benchmark. The data are synthetic results, not field measurements. The 1.5 GB and 134 MB files were not downloaded, and numerical agreement between the three engines was not recalculated.
